title: skills: objectstack-data field-types should name --org / --all-organizations on the record-currency backfill hint (PR #30737)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cytLmJxfAmgPVjUbbW

Filing gate: a `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line from PR #30737 (#30674, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** PR #30737 scopes `os migrate record-currency-codes` per organization. On a database with more than one organization, a run without `--org` is now refused before any write, and `--all-organizations` is the explicit way to write one code into every organization. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` (the currency-resolution paragraph, "Switched a stored field to `'record'`? Backfill: `os migrate record-currency-codes`.") names neither flag, so an agent that follows the skill on a multi-organization database runs straight into the refusal.

**Wanted.** Extend that one hint so it names `--org <id>` for a single organization, `--all-organizations` for the explicit write-all, and that a multi-organization database refuses a run with neither. Keep it to the line's current length budget. It owes `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. Land it after PR #30737 merges, so the skill matches `main`. `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` is already updated by the PR.

Reader: `domain:skills` (`skills/**`). Suggested-grade: p3 · a one-line skill hint that follows a narrowing.
